title: Gas Lantern Off
keywords: Fuel-burning light source that contributes carbon to Basic/Advanced Greenhouses

blocks.text: Fuel-burning light source that contributes carbon to Basic/Advanced Greenhouses.

rows: Put ordinary furnace fuel in the lantern.
Place it within the greenhouse’s eligible space.
Keep it burning and observe greenhouse carbon over time.

blocks.text: The item’s registry ID says off because active state controls its lighting. A spent lantern cannot provide ongoing carbon.
